query:
SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
                'factory_merge_turn:'
                    || lower(regexp_replace(btrim(repo_url), '\.git$', ''))
                    || ' ' || base_branch,
                0
            )) AS "taken!"
            FROM factory_run
            WHERE id = $1 AND repo_url IS NOT NULL AND base_branch IS NOT NULL
